notes: Source agents must point at context/README.md, stay under maxAgentLines, and must not embed product facts (brand names, colors, fonts, domains, git remotes) or a hardcoded exclusive package manager. Split oversized roles into agents/<role>/*.md partials and reference them from the entry file. `hygiene` always lints this package's own agents/ — never a consuming repo's local overrides — so this list stays generic, not any one product's facts.
